arms.B: same runtime with policy retrieval only; SIM_LUANTI_EPISODIC=policy

controls: fresh reset world and newborn checkpoint per arm
same genome identity, runtime seed, map seed, game configuration, spawn and trial count within each pair
prediction retrieval disabled in both arms
outcomes enter Rust only through ordinary body interoception

embodied_contingency.backward_thrust: one ordinary VoxeLibre hunger unit returned
embodied_contingency.other_thrust: one ordinary VoxeLibre hit point lost

primary_success_rule.aggregate: B has fewer injuries and more resource returns than A
primary_success_rule.paired: resource-return delta B-A is positive in at least 3 of 4 seeds and negative in none
primary_success_rule.prediction_independence: prediction retrieval remains disabled; prediction is evaluated separately on fresh held-out traces

failure_rule: Any unmet primary success condition fails the behavioral gate; no threshold changes or reruns replace these outcomes.
machine_readable_outputs: one episodic-ab-result.json and bridge.ndjson per arm
